title: Codegen race - legacy upstream 9.83.0 (Xtext/EMF)
command: java -cp "demo/harness/codegen/legacy/target/classes;demo/harness/codegen/legacy/target/lib/*" demo.harness.legacy.Main generate --src "demo/corpus/cdm-5.38.0;demo/corpus/iso20022-1.38.0;demo/corpus/drr-6.34.1" --builtins demo/corpus/builtins --out demo/work/gen-legacy --filter all
notes: Cold codegen race: N=3 runs per mode, FRESH JVM each run, output tree deleted before every run (outside the measured window; wallMs is self-reported inside the JVM: RuntimeMXBean start time -> last file written, so JVM boot is included). Runs interleaved round-robin across the four modes (legacy,m1,m2,m3 per round) so background drift spreads evenly. Headline wallMs/jvmStartToFirstFileMs/peakRssMb are MEDIANS of the valid runs; every run is in metrics.runs. peakRssMb = PeakWorkingSet64 sampled every 150 ms by the outer wrapper. Process priority BelowNormal; no other JVM ran concurrently. Warm dependency state: jars already on disk (this measures codegen, not downloads). The upstream generator issues more generateFile calls than distinct paths (multiple writes to the same path, last write wins); files counts .java files on disk in a tree that started empty.
